stories.headline: BTS Will Not Enter ‘Arirang’ Songs for Consideration at 2027 Grammy Awards - Billboard
stories.summary: BTS has announced that they will not be submitting music from their comeback "Arirang" album for consideration at the 2027 Grammy Awards.
stories.why: BTS's Grammy snub signals K-pop's shift from Western validation—the biggest boy band on Earth is confident enough to compete on their own terms, reshaping what 'making it' means for global artists.

stories.headline: Marjorie Taylor Greene Ties the Knot With Brian Glenn in Las Vegas - TMZ
stories.summary: Marjorie Taylor Greene is now officially off the market ... because she just got hitched to her fiancé Brian Glenn in Las Vegas!
stories.why: MTG's Vegas wedding to a lesser-known political operative is a cultural marker of how MAGA figures operate outside traditional institutions; it's the political equivalent of moving fast and breaking things.

stories.headline: Oscar-winning songwriter Glen Hansard killed in crash - BBC
stories.summary: Hansard, who was 56, won the best song Oscar for the 2007 low-budget musical film Once.
stories.why: Hansard's death at 56 cuts short a rare career where indie folk credibility and Oscar legitimacy intersected—he represented a specific 2000s-2010s moment when art-house cinema still had massive cultural weight.

stories.headline: King Charles sends 'defiance' message to Prince William with Buckingham Palace room offer to Harry: expert - Fox News
stories.summary: Royal experts say Prince William demands hard boundaries with Prince Harry while King Charles seeks healing, creating a rift over the monarchy's future.
stories.why: The Harry-William split over Charles's olive branch isn't gossip—it's about whether the monarchy survives Gen X and younger men's expectations of emotional accountability versus institutional duty.

stories.headline: ‘Super Troopers’ at 25: A quarter-century of mustaches and maple syrup — and a new film - AP News
stories.summary: A quarter of a century is a long time for mustache rides and syrup binges, but “Super Troopers” has gotten a lot of mileage out of the simple joys of friends goofing around. The comedy troupe Broken…
stories.why: Super Troopers' 25-year relevance and new film prove that dumb-funny comedy with genuine ensemble chemistry ages better than prestige comedy; it's the working man's Coen Bros.

stories.headline: Kavinsky, French Producer and DJ Behind ‘Drive’ Opening Song ‘Nightcall,’ Dies at 50 - Variety
stories.summary: Kavinsky, the French DJ whose anthem 'Nightcall' became a cult classic after opening Nicolas Winding Refn’s 'Drive,' has died. He was 50.
stories.why: Kavinsky's death removes one of the last bridges between 2010s synth-wave nostalgia and legitimate underground production—that 'Drive' era aesthetic is now fully locked in the past.

stories.headline: Jared Leto Accused of Sexual Misconduct by Four Women in New BBC Doc - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: In all, 10 women — some of whom say they were teenagers when the incidents occurred — make allegations against the Oscar winner and rock star in the doc, 'Jared Leto: Hollywood’s Dark Secret.'
stories.why: The BBC doc's scale (10 women, some minors) transforms Leto from flaky eccentric into a systemic abuser case, signaling that even A-list rock stars can't outrun #MeToo accountability anymore.
